own_solution.law: Impulse–momentum gives F_avg = m_eff v(1 + e)/dt. The rebound speed is 12 m/s, so the base force is 0.150(20 + 12)/0.008 = 600 N. With attached clay of mass q, m_eff = 0.150 + q/1000 kg.
assumptions: Clay described as stuck to the ball remains attached throughout the collision.
The stated approach speed, restitution and contact duration apply to each augmented problem.
The wall supplies the significant external impulse to the ball and any attached clay, with contact occurring through the ball.

notes: All certified answers agree with impulse–momentum: attached clay masses of 35, 75 and 120 g give 740, 900 and 1080 N, respectively. Every disconnected rendering gives 600 N. Masses and times must be interpreted with their stated units; conversion to kilograms and seconds gives newtons.
